g.text: Data permit and contract negotiation (ArchiMate 3.2, business process view)
three phases: the EHDS permit of Chapter IV, the Dataspace Protocol's negotiation, the transfer
Phase 1: discovery and the data permit (Regulation (EU) 2025/327, Chapter IV)
assignment: the role that starts the phase; every step names its role
triggering: one step starts the next
access: issues, writes or delivers the object
flow: the permit travels with the request
serving: the application service the step runs on
